name: Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform cadet officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-male-long; blank grade)
size_basis: The slide-on epaulet sleeve as it lies on the shirt's strap: the strap's edge-on band (0.46 in thick, LIVE10-ART 2; the strap itself is 0.9 in wide), one axis from the armhole seam to the collar end, cut square across 0.5 in + the button + 0.06 in short of the strap's point so the button shows; same outer end, same two long edges, upper edge the shoulder line, so it covers the strap and nothing else (Fig 4.16: the gray sleeve is as wide as the strap, 0.88-0.94 in at the pocket's 5.25 in). The top-down view is the separate asset garment-aviator-epaulet-top-*. Colours are those of the top-down sleeve assets (rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-* #5f5c5c, measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1; cadet officers the family grade-cloth blue #142347, assets/epaulet-sleeve-colours.js), as the Class B sleeves, so the strip on the shirt and the view from above show one sleeve; the regulation gives no shade or dimension.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)
documented: grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)
assumed: sleeve length (ends short of the strap button)
grade not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot (centre of the sleeve, on the strap axis)
